title: fix(2d): the Face raster takes a start pick and an exit pick
body:
## What changed

The Face operation takes a start pick and an exit pick. It reads them from the operation-level `picks` of PR #3871.

- **Start.** The raster starts at the corner of the face region that is nearest the start pick. The edge row at that corner is cut first, away from the corner. The rows then step to the far edge.
- **Exit with a start.** The exit pick names the side where the last row ends. An even row count ends on the side of the start corner. An odd row count ends on the opposite side. A side that the row count cannot reach is refused by name.
- **Exit alone.** The planner chooses the start corner that ends the last row at the corner nearest the exit pick.
- **No pick.** The path is the automatic raster, byte for byte.
- **Rotated work offset (review round 1).** A work offset with a Z rotation carries the geometry into the generator frame. `wcs_yaw::rotate_params` now carries each start and exit pick with it. The rule reads `OpParams::path_picks_mut`, so it holds for each kind that stores picks.
- **2D Contour under a rotated work offset (review round 2).** The same rule changes one more kind. Before, a Contour start or exit pick did not turn into the generator frame, and the cut entered on the wrong wall. Now the cut enters and leaves at the picks. This changes the Contour toolpath and its posted G-code for a job that has a pick and a Z-rotated work offset.
- **Rows cut short (review round 1).** The picks are judged again on the rows that each level cuts, after the holes law and the "Do not touch" keep-out (`face_raster::Raster::held`). The first piece of the first row must start on the side of the start pick. The last piece of the last row must end on the side of the exit pick. If not, the cut is refused, and the text names the blocked pick. The protected area stays clear.
- **Tilted (3+2) Face.** A pick is refused by name, as on the tilted 2D Contour.
- **Page.** The Face Geometry tab shows typed Start point and Exit point groups.
- **MCP.** `edit_operation` sets the picks. Its schema text names the Face rule. `list_operation_types` reports `start_exit` as taken for Face.

The refusal text for a blocked pick is: `Face: the exit point is blocked at Z -2.000 - a hole or a protected 'Do not touch' item takes the last row beside it, so the raster cannot exit at that corner; clear or move the exit point, or free the row`.

The refusal text for the row count is: `Face: the exit point is nearest the other side - a raster of 6 rows from the start corner ends at the start corner's own side; clear the exit point, start at the other corner of the first row, or change the stepover (the row count)`.

Files:

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/face_raster.rs` (new): the planning rule.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/face.rs`: the new entry point `face_picked`. `face_over_kept` calls it with no pick. The file has 400 lines.
- `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs`: Face answers `PickCapability::Raster`. A tilted Face refuses a pick.
- `crates/app/src/operation/boundary_turn.rs`, `generate.rs`: the Face arm passes the picks. The picks are turned into the laid frame of an open boundary.
- `crates/app/src/operation/wcs_yaw.rs`: the picks go into the generator frame with the geometry.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`: the schema text.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/start_exit_rows.rs`, `mill2d_page.rs`: the typed groups.
- `docs/decisions/3326-face-start-exit.md`: the decisions.

## Cause

`face_over_kept` set the first row and its direction from the Climb switch only. `KindInfo::pick()` answered "not taken" for Face, so the command door refused each pick.

## Where the issue is silent

I chose the smallest rule in each case. The decision file gives the reasons.

- An exit pick without a start pick: the planner chooses the start corner that reaches the exit. The issue names the start corner as a cause of the refusal, and here the user stated no start corner.
- An exit pick with a start pick is judged by its side only (the words of the issue). When the exit pick is nearer the first row, the path has a note that says where the raster ends.
- A pick at equal distance from two sides takes the low side.
- From a high Y corner the rows are the same band in the opposite order. The band is not mirrored, so the rows never change.
- The pick is stated in the setup's frame. It is carried into the frame of the face region (an open boundary turn, a rotated work offset) before the corner is read.
- A row that a keep-out cuts short, but that still starts (or ends) on the picked side, is accepted. A row that is taken is refused. The planner does not move the entry or the exit to a different row.
- The Face page has typed rows only. A viewport Pick button is not in this change: `start_exit_pick` writes to the 2D Contour only, and PR #3978 changes that file.

## Tests

Pins (all new, all green on the final head):

- `crates/motion/tests/face_start_exit.rs` (14 tests):
  - `start_at_the_low_x_low_y_corner_matches_golden`, `start_at_the_high_x_low_y_corner_matches_golden`, `start_at_the_low_x_high_y_corner_matches_golden`, `start_at_the_high_x_high_y_corner_matches_golden` (one golden CL each)
  - `an_exit_on_the_side_the_last_row_reaches_is_taken`
  - `an_exit_the_row_count_cannot_reach_is_refused_by_name`
  - `an_exit_alone_ends_the_last_row_at_its_corner`
  - `an_exit_beside_the_first_row_says_where_the_raster_ends`
  - `no_pick_is_the_automatic_face_to_the_byte`
  - `blended_turns_stay_outside_the_footprint_from_every_corner`
  - `the_holes_bound_the_same_row_pieces_from_every_corner`
  - `the_lead_runs_on_along_the_picked_first_row`
  - `a_pick_no_planner_can_read_is_refused`
  - `a_keep_out_that_takes_a_terminal_row_refuses_the_blocked_pick_by_name` (review round 1)
- `crates/app/tests/face_start_exit.rs` (10 tests):
  - `the_raster_enters_at_each_picked_corner`
  - `the_picked_corner_over_the_stock_matches_golden`
  - `an_exit_the_rows_cannot_reach_is_refused_by_name_and_a_reachable_one_is_cut`
  - `undo_and_redo_restore_the_previous_path`
  - `mcp_edit_operation_sets_the_face_picks`
  - `a_tilted_face_refuses_a_pick_at_the_door`, `a_file_with_a_pick_on_a_tilted_face_is_refused_by_name`
  - `the_air_entry_runs_on_along_the_picked_first_row`
  - `the_registry_says_the_face_takes_a_start_and_an_exit`
  - `a_rotated_work_offset_reads_the_picks_in_the_setup_frame` (review round 1)
- `crates/app/src/operation/boundary_turn.rs`: `a_start_pick_names_the_part_corner_under_every_turn`
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/start_exit_tests.rs`: `the_face_geometry_tab_states_and_clears_its_start_and_exit`
- `crates/app/tests/contour_start_point.rs`: `a_rotated_work_offset_reads_the_contour_picks_in_the_setup_frame` (review round 2). A 90-degree work offset about the origin, a start pick at (36, 0) and an exit pick at (0, 26). The lead-in ends at (35, 0) and the lead-out leaves at (0, 25).
- `crates/app/tests/slot_start_exit.rs` (from #3978, not changed): the four `the_*_pick_holds_under_*_degree_wcs_yaw` tests pin the one rotation of the Slot picks on the merged tree.

Red before the fix: the motion pin did not compile on unchanged `upstream/main` (`unresolved import camcraft_motion::machining2d::face_picked`). The first mutation below is the old behaviour with the new entry point, and it fails 10 of the 13 motion tests.

Mutation results. I applied each mutation, ran the pin, saw it fail, and restored the code.

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| The facer ignores the picks (the old raster) | red: 10 of 13 motion tests |
| The exit refusal is removed | red: `an_exit_the_row_count_cannot_reach_is_refused_by_name` |
| The arc sense is the old one (`ccw = forward`) | red: `blended_turns_stay_outside_the_footprint_from_every_corner` |
| The corner arc centres step up always | red: the same test |
| The reversal plan is not put in cut order | red: the same test |
| The pick sanity check is removed | red: `a_pick_no_planner_can_read_is_refused` |
| The exit note is removed | red: `an_exit_beside_the_first_row_says_where_the_raster_ends` |
| The picks are not turned into the laid frame | red: `a_start_pick_names_the_part_corner_under_every_turn` |
| Face answers "not taken" (the old capability) | red: 6 of the app tests |
| The tilted Face guard is removed | red: `a_tilted_face_refuses_a_pick_at_the_door`, `a_file_with_a_pick_on_a_tilted_face_is_refused_by_name` |
| The Face arm drops the picks | red: 4 of the app tests |
| The air entry closure drops the picks | red: `the_air_entry_runs_on_along_the_picked_first_row` |
| Review round 1: the picks are not carried into the frame of the rotated work offset | red: `a_rotated_work_offset_reads_the_picks_in_the_setup_frame` (the exit is refused, because the start took the wrong corner) |
| Review round 1: the check on the cut rows is removed | red: `a_keep_out_that_takes_a_terminal_row_refuses_the_blocked_pick_by_name` (the path is cut, not refused) |
| Review round 2: the pick rule after the `match` is removed (no pick turns) | red: `a_rotated_work_offset_reads_the_contour_picks_in_the_setup_frame`, `a_rotated_work_offset_reads_the_picks_in_the_setup_frame`, and the four Slot yaw tests |
| Review round 2: the Slot arm turns its picks too (the result of a clean git merge) | red: the four Slot yaw tests of `slot_start_exit.rs` |
| The Face page draws no pick rows | red: `the_face_geometry_tab_states_and_clears_its_start_and_exit` |

Tests changed because this change extends what they pin:

- `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs`, `every_kind_has_one_pick_capability_and_only_the_taken_ones_take_a_pick`: Face is now `Raster`. The panic text names the kinds that take a pick: the contour, the wire, the face, the slot and the three turning kinds.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/start_exit_tests.rs`, `kinds_without_a_picked_start_say_so_by_name`: Engrave replaces Face as the Geometry-only kind that takes no pick.

Gates on the final head `e7a7b3582`. The head contains `upstream/main` `49bfcaea8`, and the gates used that base.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green in one run. `wall 78.5 min, 933 step(s), 0 failed, 0 stalled`.
  - `app suites: contour_start_point`, `face_start_exit`, `slot_start_exit`, `start_exit_shared`: ok.
  - `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `golden_cl`, `solid_law_goldens`: ok.
  - `app suites: cadmpeg_import` and `ui suites: lib`: ok.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`, the four targeted steps that reach the Face code: `wall 1.2 min, 4 step(s), 0 failed, 0 stalled`.
  - `motion heavy: face_holes`, `motion heavy: top_z_stock_over`, `motion heavy: arc_turn_kinds`, `app heavy: example_catalog`.
  - The full heavy reach is not run: a PR never runs the full reach (#3556).
- `cargo xtask gate light`: `wall 2.6 min, 6 step(s), 0 failed, 0 stalled`.
- The gates ran without the sccache wrapper (`env -u RUSTC_WRAPPER`, `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`). The wrapper did not answer in this session.
- `upstream/main` moved to `267ee5096` after the gates started. `git merge-tree` shows that this head merges with it cleanly. The gates did not run on that newer base.

## Merge with main

The head contains a merge of `upstream/main` `49bfcaea8` (commit `411105864`, a merge commit, no rebase).

- `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs`, `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs`: text conflicts. Each side added lines (Face here; Slot and the turning kinds on main). The resolution keeps all the additions.
- `crates/app/src/operation/wcs_yaw.rs`, `rotate_params`: one hand edit, as the review of `e07a88d09` requested. Git merged the function without a conflict, but the result turned the Slot picks two times. The pick loop of the `OpParams::Slot` arm (#3978) is removed. The one rule after the `match` turns each pick one time, for each kind.
- The turning kinds of #3331 do not enter the rotated frame (`wcs_yaw::op_applies` is false for them), so the rule does not turn a lathe (Z, X) pick.

## Goldens moved

No shipped golden changed. `git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl"` shows five new files and no changed file:

- `crates/motion/tests/golden/face_start_low_x_low_y.cl` (new)
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/face_start_high_x_low_y.cl` (new)
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/face_start_low_x_high_y.cl` (new)
- `crates/motion/tests/golden/face_start_high_x_high_y.cl` (new)
- `crates/app/tests/golden/face_start_exit.cl` (new)

The review commits of round 1 and round 2 add or change no recorded program. Between `e07a88d09` and `e7a7b3582` the only recorded file that differs is `wire_dxf_spline_die.nc`, and it comes from main in the merge.

The recorded catalog did not change. The debug suites `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `golden_cl` and `solid_law_goldens` passed in the quick gate on `e7a7b3582`, and the release lane `app heavy: example_catalog` passed.

## Before and after UI screenshots

The Face operation page, Geometry tab. The harness of the UI tests renders the real page code.

| Before (`upstream/main`) | After, no pick | After, the two picks stated |
|---|---|---|
| ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d0088946da740cd80afb32a57f6d2e22c5121b75/pr-3997/before-face-geometry.png) | ![after, off](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d0088946da740cd80afb32a57f6d2e22c5121b75/pr-3997/after-face-geometry-off.png) | ![after, on](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d0088946da740cd80afb32a57f6d2e22c5121b75/pr-3997/after-face-geometry-on.png) |

- Before: the two groups say that the pick is not taken.
- After: each group has a switch. With the switch on, the group shows typed X and Y rows and a Clear button.
- The images are only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, at `d0088946da740cd80afb32a57f6d2e22c5121b75`, in the folder `pr-3997/`. No image is in this PR branch.

## Not exercised

- No posted G-code test with a pick. The pick changes the order of the CL moves only, and the post reads the CL.
- A pick on a Face with "Do not touch" items is tested in the motion crate with a keep-out region. No app test sets a pick with a real protected item.
- A hole that takes a terminal row under a pick: the same check reads the hole pieces, but the test uses a keep-out only.
- A pick under a rotated work offset is tested for Face, 2D Contour and Slot. The rule also turns the stored picks of the other kinds that enter the rotated frame. No such kind reads a pick now, so no test covers them.
- No posted G-code test for a Contour with a pick under a rotated work offset. The test reads the generated path.
- A staged Face (Top Z with a stepdown) with a pick: each level runs the same ordered rows; no test sets the two together.
- An exit pick on a Face laid along an open boundary (only the start pick is tested in the turned frame).
- The viewport Pick button for the Face (not in this change; see "Where the issue is silent").

## Overlaps

No open PR changes the Face functions. These open PRs of the same series change other arms or other functions of the same files. Whichever merges second refreshes.

- #3978 (Slot) is merged and is in this head (see "Merge with main"). It changed: `generate.rs` (Slot arm), `pick_kinds.rs` (Slot arm), `machining2d/mod.rs` (exports), `start_exit_shared.rs`, `start_exit_rows.rs`, `start_exit_tests.rs`.
- #3970 (Drill, Bore, Thread): `mcp/tools.rs` (the same schema sentence), `generate.rs`, `pick_kinds.rs`, `start_exit_shared.rs`, `start_exit_rows.rs`, `start_exit_tests.rs`.
- #3981 (turning): `mcp/tools.rs` (the same schema sentence), `generate.rs`, `pick_kinds.rs`, `start_exit_shared.rs`.
- #3980 (sinker): `mcp/tools.rs` (the same schema sentence), `pick_kinds.rs`, `start_exit_shared.rs`.
- #3832, #3674, #3103 change other arms of `generate.rs`. #3963 changes a different tool in `mcp/tools.rs`.

The capability test in `start_exit_shared.rs` and the schema sentence in `mcp/tools.rs` are one statement each, so the second PR to merge has a text conflict there. The resolution keeps the two additions.

Changelog: Face takes a start point and an exit point: the raster starts at the corner nearest the start point, and the last row ends on the side nearest the exit point or the cut is refused by name (#3326). 2D Contour: a start or exit point under a Z-rotated work offset is now read in the setup's frame; before, the cut entered and left on the wrong wall.

Effort: max

Fixes #3326
